title: Check Eligibility
description: Verify that you meet all the eligibility requirements to register as a voter in India.
requirements: You must be a citizen of India
You must have attained the age of 18 years on the qualifying date (1st January of the year of revision of the electoral roll)
You must be an ordinary resident of the constituency where you wish to be registered
You must not be disqualified under any law (e.g., unsound mind as declared by a competent court, disqualified for corrupt practices or election offences)
action_items: Calculate your age as of 1st January of the current year
Confirm you are an Indian citizen (not an Overseas Citizen of India cardholder, which is different from an Indian citizen)
Identify your ordinary place of residence and the constituency it falls under
NRI citizens with valid Indian passports can register using Form 6A

title: Fill Form 6 Online
description: Submit Form 6 (Application for Inclusion of Name in Electoral Roll) through the official online portal.
requirements: Access to the National Voters' Service Portal (NVSP) or Voter Helpline App
A valid mobile number for OTP verification
A recent passport-sized colour photograph (JPEG, under 50KB)
Basic personal details: name, date of birth, address, father's/mother's/husband's name
action_items: Visit https://voters.eci.gov.in or download the 'Voter Helpline' app from Play Store/App Store
Click on 'New Voter Registration' or 'Form 6'
Fill in all required fields: Part number, Assembly constituency, personal details
Upload your passport-sized photograph
Verify your mobile number via OTP
Submit the form and note down your Application Reference ID
You can also submit Form 6 offline through your local Booth Level Officer (BLO) or the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO)

title: Prepare Required Documents
description: Keep your identity and address proof documents ready for verification by the Booth Level Officer.
requirements: One proof of age (any one): Birth certificate, 10th class mark sheet, Indian passport, PAN card, Aadhaar card
One proof of address (any one): Aadhaar card, ration card, Indian passport, utility bill (electricity/water/gas — recent), bank passbook with updated address, rent agreement with notarization
One recent passport-sized photograph (same as uploaded in Form 6)
action_items: Gather original documents — the BLO may visit your residence for physical verification
Keep photocopies ready as well
If you have an Aadhaar card, it serves as both age and address proof
For NRIs using Form 6A: valid Indian passport is mandatory
Ensure your name spelling matches across all documents

title: Locate Your Polling Booth
description: Find your designated polling station where you will cast your vote on election day.
requirements: Your constituency and part number (available on the NVSP portal after registration)
Your EPIC number (Voter ID number) or application reference ID
action_items: Visit https://voterportal.eci.gov.in and click on 'Know Your Polling Station'
Alternatively, use the Voter Helpline App → 'Know Your' → 'Polling Booth'
You can also send an SMS: EPIC <space> <Voter ID Number> to 1950
Call the Voter Helpline at 1950 (toll-free) for assistance
Note down your polling station name, address, and booth number
Visit the location once before election day so you know the route

title: Verify Your Name on the Voter List
description: Confirm that your name appears correctly on the final electoral roll before election day to avoid any issues during voting.
requirements: Your EPIC number (Voter ID card number) or your full name and address details
Access to the Electoral Search portal or the Voter Helpline App
action_items: Visit https://electoralsearch.eci.gov.in
Search by EPIC number (recommended — fastest) or by personal details (name + father's name + age + state + constituency)
Verify that your name, age, gender, address, and photograph are correct
If there are errors, file Form 8 (Correction of Entries) via the NVSP portal
If your name is missing, file a fresh Form 6 application
Check the voter list well before elections — last-minute additions may not be processed
Collect your EPIC (Voter ID card) from the ERO office if you haven't received it yet — you can also download the e-EPIC from the Voter Helpline App
